'''Elma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] technician in charge of maintaining the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] at the [[Q'Maere Research Facility]]. Formerly a member of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]], his loyalty came under suspicion and he was sent to the [[Re-Education/Legends|Re-Education]] branch to be "re-brained". He was part of the staff left behind when [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] abandoned the facility. Elma was shy and meek, and would cower at trouble.
